title: Heralded Entanglement Transfer from Entangled Atomic Pair to Free Electrons
summary: We propose a protocol that transfers entanglement from an entangled atomic two-level-system (TLS) resource to a pair of free electrons in an energy-sideband ladder via local electron-TLS interactions. In a controlled rotating-wave regime, closed-form reduced states are derived. TLS heralding then prepares a maximally entangled electron state in a two-dimensional single-excitation manifold, with a simple dependence on the initial TLS resource entanglement.
